repl_description:
A sci-fi themed AI agent simulation platform enabling agent deployment with real-time monitoring and visualization capabilities. The system implements agent-to-agent communication through a node graph visualization system, backed by WebSocket communication for live updates and system metrics tracking.

The platform features world context management and Claude API integration for agent interactions, with comprehensive system monitoring and error handling mechanisms. The system supports real-time agent operations within a managed environment, complete with rate limiting and performance tracking.

Key Components:
- Claude API integration
- WebSocket communication layer
- Node graph visualization system
- World context management
- Agent deployment and monitoring
- System logging and metrics
- Rate limiting and error handling
